Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the Super Over! Aaron Jones and Harmeet Singh walk out to the middle for USA. And it will be Mohammad Amir to bowl those six crucial balls for Pakistan.
... SUPER OVER ...

WE ARE GOING THE DISTANCE IN DALLAS! IT IS SUPER OVER TIME, FOLKS! With 12 runs needed off the last three balls, the game looked to be in Pakistan's bag but Aaron Jones's maximum and Nitish Kumar's boundary off the last ball has helped the USA take the game to a Super Over. Babar Azam is crossed with Haris Rauf for his choice of delivery on the last ball. The game has swung back and forth so far and now, we are in for quite the ride in the Super Over. In case you were wondering, it will be the USA to bat first in the Super Over.

FOUR! NITISH KUMAR HAS JUST PULLED OFF SOMETHING UNBELIEVABLE HERE! GUESS WHAT? THE GAME ENDS UP IN A TIE AND A SUPER OVER WILL FOLLOW! Haris misses his mark and bowls a knee-length full toss on off, Nitish Kumar cashes onto it and picks the bones out of it, and clears mid off for a boundary. What a cracker of a contest! Babar Azam is absolutely livid here and why not?

Commentary.Commentary: A well-executed yorker on the middle, Aaron Jones digs it out straight down the ground for a single. The fielders from long on and long off converge but just a single is taken. Are we going to have a super over here? Or can Nitish Kumar pull off a heist here?

Naseem bowls it on a length, around the fourth stump line, Andries Gous goes for a straight drive but the ball nips away a shade and takes the thickish outside edge that drops just short of first slip where Iftikhar Ahmed is late to react. The ball guns down to the fence at deep third.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Naseem Shah to Andries Gous, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Andries Gous walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Finally, a breakthrough for Pakistan and Naseem strikes! Naseem Shah steams in from over the wicket, hits the deck hard, the ball nips away with the angle from off, Steven Taylor plays inside the line of the ball looking for a front foot drive. The ball takes the outside edge and Mohammad Rizwan dives towards his left and takes a stunning catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Naseem Shah
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Naseem Shah to Steven Taylor, OUT! c Mohammad Rizwan b Naseem Shah.

Commentary.Commentary: Attacks the stumps, on a hard length, Steven Taylor gets rushed as he looks to keep it out. Gets an inside edge that rolls to the right of the keeper for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery, angled into the pads, Steven Taylor rolls his wrists and works it in the vacant mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Slants it into the pads again, on a length, Steven Taylor shapes up to whip it away with the angle but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Angling in, on a good length, clipped straight to mid-wicket by Steven Taylor.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Sloppy! Rolls his fingers over the side of the ball and lands it on a good length, on middle, Monank Patel waits on it and dabs it towards backward point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Top shot! Amir goes short but the line is around leg, Monank Patel gets on top of the bounce nicely and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Amir (1-0-8-0) switches end and is back into the attack.

Cries of 'catch it' but it clears the man! Naseem goes into the wicket, over middle, Monank Patel gets himself into an awkard position and gets into two minds for the pull. Luckily for him, the ball clears the man at mid-wicket. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Naseem Shah to Monank Patel, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good early call! Serves it on a good length, on the off-stump line, Steven Taylor defends it close to his body and gets across quickly as the ball rolls in front of cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Naseem Shah to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Aims the stumps, on middle and full, Monank Patel clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Naseem Shah to Monank Patel, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Straight and full on the stumps, Monank Patel mistimes the straight drive off the inside half of the bat to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Naseem Shah to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, on off, Monank Patel drives well but picks out the man at mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Naseem Shah to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts with a full delivery, on off, Steven Taylor advances down the track for the drive but gets an inside edge to short fine leg. Monank Patel calls him through and although Taylor is late to set off, he makes his ground at the bowling end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Naseem Shah to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Naseem Shah replaces Mohammad Amir.

A big, big shout for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Babar Azam has a word with the bowler and the keeper and takes the review. The ball pitching outside leg might have saved Monank Patel there. And yes, as expected, it has indeed pitched outside leg on Ball Tracking. This was bowled on a back of a length, shaping back in, on middle, Monank Patel played all around it and got struck right in front of the stumps. Luckily for him, it pitched outside leg. Pakistan lose their review.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nothing fortuitous about this one! Low full toss, outside off, Monank Patel leans onto the drive and creams it through extra cover for a classy boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: EDGED AND FOUR! Fortuitous boundary for the USA skipper! Shaheen pitches it up, on off, Monank Patel shapes up for the straight drive but does not account for the angle. The ball catches the outside edge and flies through the gap between the keeper, Mohammad Rizwan and Iftikhar Ahmed, standing at a wide slip. It was closer to Iftikhar than it was to Rizwan but the former did not make any attempt.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Bangs it on a hard length but the line is down leg, Monank Patel misses the tickle. Wide given.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: A fumble and the batters cross over. Lands it full, on off, Steven Taylor shows the full face of the bat and firms the drive to Amir at mid off who lets it through his legs and concedes a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Width on offer on off, fuller in length, Steven Taylor's eyes light as he sees the width and looks to go back over the bowler's head but connects with thin air.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Angles it on a hard length, on middle, Steven Taylor covers the line of the ball and defends it out solidly.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is just outside off, on a good length, Monank Patel goes for the drive but miscues it off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Monank Patel is away, albeit in a streaky fashion! Angling away, on a length, outside off, Monank Patel skips down the track to force it through the off side. Gets it off the toe-end of the bat but it goes wide of backward point for a boundary. Monank has damaged the bottom part of his bat and needs a replacement.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Attacks the stumps, on a nagging length, swinging back in, Monank Patel is late to pick it but does well to keep it out on the leg side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Errs in line does Amir as he bowls it full but way down leg. Monank Patel misses to help it away. Wide given.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Going across the right-hander from over the wicket, on a back of a length, Monank Patel goes after it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Mohammad Amir to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good stop! Going away from the left-hander, on a length, Steven Taylor looks to drive it through the off side but gets a thickish outside edge that goes on the bounce to backward point. Shadab Khan dives to his left and keeps it down to one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Much better from Amir as this is in the channel on off, on a good length, shaping away, left alone by Steven Taylor.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Pakistan cannot afford this! Amir overcorrects and slips it way beyond the wide guideline on off, on a back of a length.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A wayward start from Amir! Steams in from over the wicket and tries to angle it back into the left-hander but drifts down leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Mohammad Amir to Steven Taylor, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Amir to operate from the other end for Pakistan.

Has Monank Patel been strangled down the leg side? Babar Azam has a chat with the bowler and the keeper before opting out of the review. No wide signalled by the umpire, so, it might have come off the pads. Shaheen serves it too straight, full and on the pads, Monank Patel misses the tickle as Mohammad Rizwan gathers it cleanly moving away to his left.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shaheen gets the length wrong as the attempted yorker comes out as a full toss, at 136.3 kph, at the stumps, Monank Patel gets caught by surprise a bit and watchfully nudges it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shaheen Afridi to Monank Patel, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good early call and they make it. Keeps it full again, on off, Steven Taylor leans on it and pushes it wide of cover before calling Monank Patel through for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A gift for Steven Taylor to open his account! Shaheen misses his mark as he serves a low full toss, around off, Steven Taylor powers the drive through covers for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! USA are underway with an extra! Shaheen gets a good away shape but the line is beyond the tramline on off. Steven Taylor lets it go for a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Pulls the length back and bowls it in the channel on off, Steven Taylor is taken aback slightly by the extra bounce but adjusts well to drop his wrists and lets the ball go.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Gets good shape right away! Begins from over the wicket and pitches it right away, swinging away, on off, Steven Taylor looks to drive it down the ground but gets it off the outer half of the bat to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shaheen Afridi to Steven Taylor, No run.
